description: This file defines a Java interface 'SubscriptionEvent' related to subscription events in the 'thing-search' component of the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods and constants for handling subscription event data, including retrieving subscription IDs and resource types.

classes.name: SubscriptionEvent
classes.description: An interface for subscription-related events in the thing-search component, providing constants and method signatures for subclasses to implement.

methods.name: getSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the subscription ID associated with the event.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto headers on the event, returning the event instance for chaining.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string for subscription events.
